## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The PR adds a retry helper, tests, and a proposed policy update. The helper exceeds the manifest-provided five-attempt limit and requires correction before merge.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When an upstream repeatedly raises OSError, the default call makes 10 attempts, exceeding the governing AGENTS.md limit of 5; the validation also permits explicit limits above 5. — Doubles upstream requests during an outage, violating the retry safeguard established after prior outages.

- Exhaustion re-raises the final exception, preserving its diagnostic information.
